verdict.rationale: Plaid documents API products that return account, routing, balance, identity and up to 24 months of transaction data to programs. The SDK pattern (plaidClient.transactionsSync, error.response.data) implies structured API responses an automated workflow can consume. However, the pack shows no explicit JSON schema documentation, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: evidence of documented response schemas or a published OpenAPI spec, evidence of transaction enrichment (categories, merchant cleanup), and independent hands-on confirmation of clean agent-consumable output.
